name: Insane 2 Nation
description: Insane 2 Nation (i2n) is a Chicago street gang based in the Hamlin Park neighborhood on the city's North Side. Active at least from the 1980s, the gang was aligned with the People Nation and formed a close alliance with the Spanish Cobras, together known as the "Green and Black Machine." The i2n was involved in prolonged territorial conflicts with the Latin Kings over control of Hamlin Park.
